description: Build the index (Window > Type & Tables > Index): add topics, page references and cross-references (New Page Reference, New Cross-reference), index selected text as a topic or a proper name (Last, First), duplicate, delete or capitalize topics, remove unused topics, import topics from another document, update the preview, go to a page reference's marker, and set sort options.

capitalization.description: capitalize: which entries; with a topic, SELECTED_ENTRY or INCLUDE_SUBENTRIES (default ALL_ENTRIES)

customText.description: add_cross_reference with a CUSTOM_* type: the custom text

filePath.description: import_topics: an InDesign document whose index topics to import

pageNumberStyle.description: Character style for this reference's page number (number style override)

properName.description: index_text: index a name as "Last, First"

referenceIndex.description: show_page_reference: which of the topic's page references, 0-based (default 0)

referenceStyle.description: TO_NEXT_USE_OF_STYLE: the paragraph style that ends the range

referencedTopic.description: add_cross_reference: the topic path referred to (created when missing)

sortOptions.description: set_sort_options: index sort groups to change

name.description: Sort group name as InDesign lists it (e.g. "Symbol", "Numeric", "Roman", "Greek", "Cyrillic")

sortOrder.description: add_topic, add_page_reference: sort the new topic as this text instead of its name

text.description: add_page_reference: the text the reference marks (a marker goes before it); index_text: the text to index

find.description: Text to find in the document (matched case-sensitively); the match is used

frameId.description: A text frame id; the text in that frame is used

length.description: With start: how many characters; 0 or absent means the point at start

occurrence.description: With find: which match to use, 1 for the first (default 1)

selection.description: Use the current text selection or text cursor

start.description: With storyId or frameId: the first character, counted from 0

storyId.description: A story id (get_document_stories lists them); its text is used

topic.description: Topic path, top level first, up to 4 levels (e.g. ["Fruit", "Apples"]). Created when missing for add_* actions; for index_text, the parent topic of the new entry

name: manage_index
title: Manage Index
